prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence for all tested change kinds (adoption/redesign, choose_path/copy, choose_path/layout, finish/notification, sign_in/hint, and sign_in/reorder) is still thin as each has only one test so far.
Predictions were consistently too high across all Round 1 tests and most Round 2 tests.
Predictions were too low for sign_in/hint, where measured results (+11.5%) significantly exceeded the predicted gain (+3.0%).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +3.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: -1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: -3.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, notification: +0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +7.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -5.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 65.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight Redesign for Companion Selection: Redesign the pet choice screen into a spotlight stage layout where active pet animations highlight companion traits. (why: Adoption step drops to 65.9% with high mean wait times; support emails report user confusion and visual setup failures during pet generation.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Screen Anchor Position Setup Screen: Insert a dedicated anchor configuration screen allowing users to pick which corner or taskbar position their pet should inhabit. (why: Multiple support emails mention pets failing to appear on the desktop or remaining hidden behind active application windows.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Adoption Certificate Creation: Shift the sign-in step to take place immediately after completing the adoption certificate instead of before pet picking. (why: Sign-in currently drops 23.4% of users early; deferring account creation until after pet creation builds user investment.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence and Quick Restore Hint: Add clear guidance text explaining how cloud account sign-in restores existing pets and prevents account duplication. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in under different credentials.)
4: [home, wait_info] Multi-Phase Initialization Status Checklist: Display explicit status steps on the waiting screen indicating desktop window initialization progress. (why: Home initialization median wait is 201s with a high mean of 2336s, causing uncertainty about whether the app has stalled.)
5: [home, notification] System Tray Alert When Companion Is Ready: Provide an option to send a native operating system notification when companion initialization completes. (why: Users experience prolonged wait times in the home step (mean 2336s), causing them to switch windows and miss readiness.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Direct Path Option Headline and Body Copy: Reframe choose_path messaging with clear action verbs contrasting instant desktop spawn against custom creation. (why: Choose_path mean completion time is 514s despite 8s median, indicating decision hesitation for a segment of users.)
7: [adoption, layout] Two-Column Layout for Pet Adoption Certificate: Convert adoption_certificate to a two-column split layout displaying the visual certificate alongside official confirmation details. (why: Adoption step drops to 65.9%; upgrading certificate visual appeal strengthens emotional attachment before desktop spawn.)
